📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-18
1. Akira Ransomware Disables EDR via Safe Mode to Steal Credentials and Files for Extortion資安
勒索軟體Akira以安全模式癱瘓EDR運作，竊取憑證與檔案進行勒索
The ransomware group Akira, which has drawn security industry attention over the past two to three years and extended its encryption scope to Nutanix virtual machines late last year, has reportedly adopted new attack techniques that are again catching security firms' attention.
近兩三年備受資安界關注的勒索軟體Akira，去年底將加密範圍延伸至Nutanix虛擬機器，如今傳出採用新攻擊手法，再度引起資安公司注意。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Actively Exploited Vulnerability in AI Framework Ray Added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities List資安
AI運算框架Ray重大漏洞遭利用，CISA列入已知遭利用漏洞名單
CISA announced on August 17 that a previously patched vulnerability (CVE-2025-62593) in the open-source distributed computing and machine learning framework Ray shows evidence of active exploitation, and has added it to the KEV catalog, requiring federal agencies to remediate.
CISA於8月17日發布公告，指出開源分散式運算與機器學習框架Ray去年修補的漏洞CVE-2025-62593已出現遭積極利用的證據，並列入KEV名單，要求聯邦機構修補。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Employee Directory Data of McDonald's, Vodafone and 7 Other Major Firms Reportedly Sold, Linked to Stolen Credentials資安
麥當勞、Vodafone等9家大型企業逾360萬筆Azure目錄資料遭兜售，疑與遭竊憑證有關
Nine major companies including McDonald's, Vodafone, Tata Consultancy Services and Kyndryl reportedly had employee directory data from their Microsoft Azure environments stolen and put up for sale.
包括麥當勞、Vodafone、TCS及Kyndryl等9家大型企業，傳出其Microsoft Azure環境員工目錄資料疑似遭竊並在網路上兜售。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Surges to $65B產業
Anthropic年化營收暴增至650億美元
The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months.
這家AI模型公司在短短兩個月內，年化營收就增加了180億美元。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
5. Groq Raises $350M to Fuel Its Pivot From AI Chips to Neocloud產業
Groq募得3.5億美元，加速從AI晶片轉型為Neocloud
Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.
Groq以35億美元估值募得3.5億美元資金，這家原本專注AI晶片的公司正轉型為neocloud業務，並擴大採用Nvidia晶片的資料中心版圖。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
6. Nvidia Investing $1.5B in SoftBank Data Center Developer Behind OpenAI Project產業
Nvidia砸15億美元投資SoftBank旗下資料中心開發商，背後牽動OpenAI專案
Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.
這筆投資將確保Nvidia晶片用於為OpenAI打造的資料中心。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Anthropic Explains How Claude's Invisible Text Watermarks Will Work政策
Anthropic說明Claude隱形文字浮水印運作方式
Anthropic clarified how it plans to apply invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text to comply with Europe's AI transparency rules, based on a version of the SynthID-Text approach.
Anthropic說明將如何為Claude生成的文字加上隱形浮水印，以符合歐洲AI透明度規範，技術採用SynthID-Text方案的變體。
The Verge · 原文連結
8. ChatGPT Now Remembers Your Mac Activity With New Computer History Feature產品
ChatGPT開始記住Mac工作軌跡，Computer History建立跨App記憶
OpenAI launched Computer History for the macOS ChatGPT app, recording user activity across apps and websites into a searchable timeline so ChatGPT and Codex can recall recent work, currently available to Pro, Business and Enterprise users.
OpenAI為macOS版ChatGPT推出Computer History功能，記錄使用者跨應用程式與網站的活動，整理成可搜尋時間軸，目前提供Pro、Business及Enterprise用戶使用。
iThome · 原文連結
9. The Defender's Window: How OpenAI Is Strengthening Cybersecurity Defenses研究
防禦者的視窗：OpenAI如何強化資安防禦
AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike; OpenAI shares how it is strengthening its own defenses and what security teams can do now.
AI正同時重塑攻擊者與防禦者的資安局勢，OpenAI分享如何強化自身防禦，並提供資安團隊可採取的行動建議。
OpenAI · 原文連結
10. DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepSeek Harness, a Modular AI Agent Execution Framework模型
DeepSeek開源DeepSeek Harness，AI代理執行環境可拆成外掛自由組合
DeepSeek open-sourced its AI agent execution framework, DeepSeek Harness, now available as a developer preview; built on the Cordis plugin system, it lets developers swap out models, tools, sandboxes and more without modifying the core source.
DeepSeek開源AI代理執行框架DeepSeek Harness，目前提供開發者預覽版，採用Cordis外掛系統，開發者可依需求更換模型、工具、沙箱等元件，不必修改原始碼。
